findings.headline: This api.subscribe listener writes setSignal; Solid 2 throws when the store notifies from an owned scope.
findings.why: The external store calls this listener synchronously from whatever changed it. When that is a component body, a createMemo compute function or a createRoot callback (or, with an immediate option, the computation that subscribes), Solid 2.0.3 throws REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE in development builds and halts the reactive system. Solid 1.x allowed these writes.
findings.guidance: This signal bridges an external store into Solid, so create it with the ownedWrite option: createSignal(initial, { ownedWrite: true }); that is what the option is for. Box a value that may be a function ({ value }) so the setter doesn't run it as an updater. Alternatively read the store through a memo that re-runs on a version signal, as long as nothing in this project updates the store from an owned scope.
